0022600008.text: Both teams are 0-1 this season: the Knicks, 9th in the East, are 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, after losing their only game so far, while the Celtics, 12th in the East, are 5th in the Atlantic, also 1.5 games back. Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with an illness, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after New York won the 2025-26 season series 3-1. The Knicks' most recent meeting with the Celtics came on April 9, 2026, in New York, when New York won 112-106.
